content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy and similar platforms promise simplicity: one dashboard for payments, delivery, and analytics. But this simplicity is rented. You depend on their infrastructure, their payment processors, and their compliance teams. When they exclude your country, you’re locked out. Alternatives like Paystack or Flutterwave offer localized payments but still rely on traditional banking rails—prone to currency controls and shutdowns. Sovereign commerce stacks, like COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack, flip this model. You own the hosting (Cloudflare Pages), the backend (Cloudflare Workers), the database (Supabase), and the payment verification (NOWPayments). No platform can revoke access. No country restrictions apply. It’s not a workaround—it’s a structural shift to infrastructure sovereignty.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Lemon Squeezy and others exclude countries based on Stripe’s and PayPal’s compliance policies. These policies are not technical—they’re financial and political. If your country is on the list, you’re blocked. Local payment gateways like Paystack work within Nigeria but fail for international buyers. Crypto-based solutions often require buyers to have wallets, adding friction. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. NOWPayments accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies with no buyer account required. Payments verify on-chain automatically, firing delivery webhooks instantly. The stack runs on globally accessible infrastructure (Cloudflare, GitHub). No single entity can restrict it. It’s built for creators in countries where traditional platforms fail by design.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Lemon Squeezy charges 5% + $0.50 per transaction, plus Stripe’s fees. Paystack and Flutterwave take 1.5–3.5% but limit currency conversions. Crypto payment processors like Coinbase Commerce charge 1%, but buyers must have a Coinbase account. NOWPayments, integrated into sovereign stacks, charges 0.5% with no buyer KYC. Transactions on BSC, Solana, or TRON cost under $0.10. The real cost difference? With platforms, fees are recurring. With sovereign stacks, you pay a one-time deployment fee ($197 for Edge Commerce Stack) and own the infrastructure. No subscriptions. No per-transaction fees after deployment. The stack pays for itself after 40 transactions—then it’s yours, forever.
Sovereign stacks replace rented platforms with owned infrastructure—no country restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Lemon Squeezy owns your customer data, payment history, and product files. If they shut down or restrict your account, you lose access. Local gateways store your data in their systems, often with unclear terms. Sovereign stacks give you full ownership. Customer data lives in your Supabase database. Product files are stored in Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. Payment verification is handled by NOWPayments webhooks, firing directly to your backend. Automation is built into the stack: payment confirms on-chain, webhook triggers, file delivers instantly. No manual steps. No platform dependence. You own the code, the data, and the process. It’s infrastructure—not a service.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in Nigeria and need to sell globally, rented platforms are not an option. Local payment gateways work for domestic buyers but fail internationally. Crypto-based solutions add friction unless your buyers are already crypto-native. Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only architecture that solves both problems. It’s globally accessible, owns no part of your stack, and automates the entire process. For creators selling digital products like ebooks, courses, or templates, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys in 48 hours with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested. It’s not the cheapest option upfront—but it’s the only one that gives you permanent infrastructure sovereignty. Choose it if you’re building a business, not a workaround.

COREMERCH deploys the stack on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages within 48 hours. 5. Test the end-to-end flow: payment, webhook, file delivery. 6. Receive full access to your deployed stack—hosting, backend, database, and payment integration. 7. COREMERCH provides 30-day support for any adjustments or questions.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed and configured by COREMERCH. You receive full access with no coding required. The stack is designed for digital creators, not developers.
What if NOWPayments restricts my country?
NOWPayments does not restrict countries. It processes payments on-chain, and the 0.5% fee is the only cost. The stack is built to work globally, regardless of your location.
How do buyers pay if they don’t have crypto?
Buyers can purchase crypto on local exchanges (Binance, Yellow Card) and pay using the stack’s payment link. The process is simple and does not require a wallet.
What happens if Cloudflare or GitHub restrict my account?
The stack is deployed on your accounts, but the architecture is decentralized. If one service restricts you, the stack can be redeployed on alternative infrastructure.
Is there a recurring fee after deployment?
No. The $197 deployment fee is one-time. You own the stack and pay no per-transaction fees beyond NOWPayments’ 0.5%.
